project_info.theme: Split-lip comparison for shade 1966 Rouge Libre
project_info.color_palette: Warm brown-gold, soft nude pink, brick red, white

main_subject.detail: A close-up beauty image of lips divided diagonally by a thin white line, showing a lighter pinkish lip look on the left and a deeper brick-red lip look on the right. The top text reads '#1966 - ROUGE LIBRE' and the bottom text reads 'ĐỎ GẠCH BIỂU TƯỢNG'.
main_subject.style: Clinical-beauty comparison poster with macro lip detail and clean split-screen presentation

composition_elements.text: #1966 - ROUGE LIBRE; ĐỎ GẠCH BIỂU TƯỢNG
items: Top Left: Large white shade name over a warm brown-gold header band
Top Right: Continuation of the warm header band
Bottom Left: Lower lip area with lighter pinkish side of the comparison
Bottom Right: Lower lip area with deeper brick-red side and large white descriptor text
Center/Background: Macro close-up of lips split diagonally by a white divider line to compare two finishes or applications

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Fine lip-line detail, even skin exposure, clean comparison clarity, subtle editorial polish

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square beauty-comparison poster for YSL shade 1966 Rouge Libre. Centerpiece is a photoreal macro close-up of lips split diagonally by a thin white line, with a lighter pinkish lip look on the left and a deeper brick-red lip look on the right. Include the exact text '#1966 - ROUGE LIBRE' and 'ĐỎ GẠCH BIỂU TƯỢNG'. Background is minimal, using a warm brown-gold header field and the lip image as the main visual. Technical style: photoreal beauty-comparison advertising composite, soft beauty macro lighting, fine lip detail and clean split-screen clarity, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Macro lip comparison reference
assets.usage: Preserve the lip shape, diagonal split line, and contrasting before/after shade rendering

assets.name: Shade-comparison typography
assets.usage: Keep the exact top and bottom text lines and their centered placement

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Keep the image clean and comparison-focused. The diagonal split line is essential. Do not add the lipstick bullet unless it is visible; the macro lips are the hero.
